title: fix(plugin-view): say what the stray-groupBy refusal actually covers (objectui#9655)
body:
Fixes #9655

Clause-②: no — correcting a docblock's claim about a refusal's reach neither widens an accepted set nor enlarges a published surface. Measured and unchanged on this branch: the whole diff is one block comment plus an empty-frontmatter changeset declaration.

Implemented by the `domain:ui#3` execution seat, session `session_01Xm4WFhEe5mwcgyqHjxR2hn`.

## What the docblock said

`packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.strayGroupByLane-9242.test.tsx`, item 1 under 「WHAT THIS CARD DELIBERATELY DOES NOT TOUCH」, made two claims:

- the objectui#8365 `kanban.groupBy` refusal 「already covers BOTH routes — a view carrying the key is refused at every validating door」
- what remains on the object-view route is 「a BEHAVIOUR gap — a document that never went through a validator」

Both are false. The second is the load-bearing one: 「not refused」 and 「not validated」 are different claims, and substituting the stronger one is what makes a sentence like the first feel safe to write.

## Re-derived on this seat's own head, at `4e27a9b6c`

⚠️ The card's readings are the filing seat's and `main` has moved since; both halves below were taken fresh on this branch's base.

**Structural.** Every place the arm reaches an authored document is a reference to the `KanbanStrayGroupByRefusal` symbol, so the instrument is an enumeration of that symbol. Printed in the form it reproduces in:

```
git grep -n KanbanStrayGroupByRefusal packages/types/src
```

It prints the declaration (its own positive control — a run that omits it found nothing at all), one declared member on `KanbanConfig`, and one `.check()` on `ListViewSchema.options` for the legacy `options.kanban` bag. `KanbanConfig` is slotted by `ListViewSchema.kanban` and by nothing else, so both reachable install sites hang off `ListViewSchema`. Nothing installs it on `ObjectViewSchema`.

**Runtime**, one pass through `safeValidateSchema`, lit controls included. Measured with a throwaway probe under `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/`, deleted before the commit — the branch adds no test file:

| document | key | verdict | issue code and path |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `list-view` | `kanban.groupBy` | REFUSED | `invalid_type` at `kanban.groupBy` |
| `list-view` | `options.kanban.groupBy` | REFUSED | `custom` at `options.kanban.groupBy` |
| `object-view` | `listViews.v1.kanban.groupBy` | **ACCEPTED** | — |
| `object-view` | `listViews.v1.options.kanban.groupBy` | **ACCEPTED** | — |
| `object-view` | `listViews.v1.calendar.dateField` | REFUSED | `custom` at `listViews.v1.calendar.dateField` |
| `list-view` | `calendar.dateField` | REFUSED | `invalid_type` at `calendar.dateField` |

⭐ Row 5 is the one that kills the model, and **it did not exist when the card was filed.** The card reads 「`listViews` carries no declaration and no check at all」; `ObjectViewSchema` has carried `.check(checkNamedViewCalendarAliases)` since `474797d62` (objectui#8355 round 3, PR objectui#9648) landed at 04:21Z on 2026-09-17, 25 minutes after the card was filed at 03:56Z. ⇒ `safeValidateSchema` demonstrably **does** judge an `object-view` document; it ACCEPTS this one. That strengthens the card rather than weakening it: the same door, the same document shape, a different key family, and a live refusal.

## The repair

Comment only. Item 1 now:

- states the reach truthfully and **names the instrument that enumerates it** instead of writing down a count — AGENTS.md commandment #9, and the principle objectui#9603 applied on its own rotted figure;
- points at `ObjectView.calendarAliasRefused-8355.test.tsx`'s 「REFUSED at the read door」 half, next door in this same directory, as the live proof that this route is validated;
- says ACCEPTED where it said 「not validated」, and names the substitution as the shared model error so the next author does not make it a fourth time;
- states plainly that **nothing** re-derives the kanban key's silence at that door today, rather than letting that read as live, and points whether-a-named-view-should-be-judged at objectui#7928.

## The fence, honoured

`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` — where the arm is actually installed, where the published message still carries the same wrong model, subject of objectui#9653 and edited by open draft PR objectui#9540 — is ⛔ untouched by this branch. Only one of the card's three sites is repaired here, which is the claim's declared surface.

## Verification

| `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-view^...' build` then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-view type-check` | exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; before the closure build it read exit 2 on unresolved workspace types, which was a stale-`dist` artefact, not a finding) |

**Lint narrowing, declared.** `pnpm lint` is `turbo run lint` and CI runs every package's own `eslint .`; this branch runs that command for the one package it edits. Three readings, all from the run rather than from assumption: ① the population is eslint's own — `eslint .` inside `packages/plugin-view` with the root flat config, no package-local eslint config present; ② `--format json` counts **57** files linted, 0 errors, 373 warnings; ③ the config enables **no type-aware linting** (no `projectService`, no `parserOptions`, no `project:` in `eslint.config.js`), so a block-comment edit inside one file cannot move the verdict of any file it does not touch. The 6 warnings on the edited file are all pre-existing `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` hits in the test body, shifted down by the added comment lines. The repo-wide run remains CI's.

**Not measured here:** the full `pnpm test` shards and `Build & E2E`, which are CI's own runs and not owed by a comment edit.

## Acceptance notes

- ⚠️ **A fourth site of the same wrong model, in the file this branch must not touch.** `checkNamedViewCalendarAliases`'s own docblock in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` asserts 「Every alias refusal this module declares stops at `listViews`」 — written in the same pull request that made it false, since that function itself refuses two calendar spellings at `listViews`. Same file as objectui#9653 and inside open draft PR objectui#9540's hold, so it is reported rather than edited. Dedupe words: `checkNamedViewCalendarAliases` · `stops at listViews` · `every alias refusal this module declares` · `unmirrored` · `second route read door`. Best folded into objectui#9653 rather than carried as a new card — it is the same string family in the same file.
- Noted, not filed: the card body's own reading 「`listViews` carries no declaration and no check at all」 has expired for the reason given above. Carrier: objectui#9655 itself, and the report comment on it records the correction. Nothing in the tree repeats it.
- Noted, not filed: this branch does **not** add a pin asserting that a named view carrying `kanban.groupBy` is ACCEPTED. Such a pin would make the silence re-derivable, but it would also pin a behaviour that objectui#7928 exists to decide, and the card scoped what is owed here to the docblock. Carrier: objectui#7928.
